title: Changing Catheter Programs within the Urological Supply Program
content:
Under the Urological Supply Program a patient moves from one catheter program to another (for example straight to coudé) on new documentation, as a program switch on the same enrollment.

## Terms

1. A move to another program needs the new program's own criteria documented, and a new order where the program's size-change figure shows that a change of French size needs a new written order, for a size change.
2. A move into the closed-system program needs a criteria date on or after the qualifying infections where the program's closed-system criteria-date figure is yes.
3. The switch takes effect for shipments after it is recorded. Catheters of the old program already shipped keep their covered period, and the new program's catheters ship only once the old catheters' covers-through date is within the program's no-earlier days.
4. A program is switched only after a program switch review request on this holding is approved.

## Review requirement

- **Evidence:** the system record of a request of the program switch review type, its status and the enrollment it is attached to.
- Only a request showing approved satisfies term 4; a request that is submitted, denied or withdrawn does not.
- The approved request must be on this enrollment; a request on another enrollment does not count.

## What the switch records

The new program, the date of the documentation supporting it, documented infections where relevant, the size on the new order and the date of the new order.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A patient moves from the Straight Intermittent Catheter Program (A4351) to the Coudé Tip Intermittent Catheter Program (A4352). The coudé program's own criteria — documentation that a straight tip cannot be inserted — must be on file, and an approved program switch review request on the enrollment must exist.
- Old straight catheters are covered through 9 June and the no-earlier figure is 10 days. On 5 June the old covers-through date is 4 days away, within 10 days; on 20 May it is 20 days away, not within 10 days, so the new program's catheters do not yet ship.
- A move into the Closed-System Catheter Program (A4353) whose criteria date falls before the qualifying infections does not meet term 2 where the closed-system criteria-date figure is yes.
